title: DDEV tar extraction can overwrite host files through absolute symlink targets
summary: An incomplete archive traversal fix validates a rebased symlink target but creates the raw absolute target. A following file entry can write outside the extraction destination.

severity.rationale: Processing an attacker-controlled archive can overwrite host files and lead to code execution. Untrusted archive processing is a developer workflow prerequisite, warranting 72 hours.

affected.note: Module github.com/ddev/ddev; affected below 1.25.4. The earlier 1.25.2 fix is incomplete.

exposure: DDEV archive extraction of attacker-controlled tar content is exposed with the extracting process privileges.

params.instructions: Check the DDEV executable version; versions below 1.25.4 require updating before untrusted archive extraction.

remediation.details: Upgrade DDEV to 1.25.4 or later before extracting untrusted archives.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating or containment can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed and running component meets the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
